desc:
RAGDOLL DODGEBALL 🏐
Grab a ball, aim, THROW... and watch them FLOP!

Floppy stick figures battle 4v4, Red vs Blue. Get hit and you go full ragdoll! Every match ends with an epic slow-mo replay of the final knockout.

🔥 HOW TO PLAY
• Throw hard for double hits and headshots
• Time your CATCH perfectly to steal the ball
• Dodge, jump and flop your way to victory
• Out of hearts? A teammate can revive you!

🎁 FEATURES
• Open Hair & Face packs to style your stick figure
• Collect rare ball skins
• Level up your Journey and finish quests for rewards
• USE YOUR HEAD! Put your own avatar's head on your stick figure
• Invite friends for bonus coins
• Play on PC, mobile, Xbox & PlayStation

👍 Leave a like and tell us what to add next!
